user.title: EcoNet Grant Aerona
user.description: Enter the connection details for your ecoNET device.

reconfigure.title: Change ecoNET connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or login of the ecoNET module. Leave the password blank to keep the saved one. Entities, history and settings are kept.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. Give the module a fixed (reserved) address in your router so it doesn't change again.
data_description.password: Leave blank to keep the current password.

reauth_confirm.title: ecoNET login rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The ecoNET module at {host} no longer accepts the saved username or password. Enter the current login.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ecoNET device.
error.wrong_device: That address answers, but it is a different ecoNET controller from the one this integration was set up with.
error.already_configured: Another EcoNet Grant entry already uses this address.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.reauth_successful: Login updated. The integration has been reloaded.
abort.address_updated: The controller's new address was found and saved.
abort.not_econet_device: This device is not a known EcoNet controller.
abort.not_ip_host: The integration uses a host name, so it isn't moved automatically.
abort.in_progress: A check of the controller's new address is already running.
abort.entry_changed: The connection was changed while the new address was being checked, so it was left as it is.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ecoNET device.
abort.wrong_device: That address answers, but it is a different ecoNET controller from the one this integration was set up with.

cannot_connect.title: EcoNet heat pump not reachable at {host}

init.title: Fix the ecoNET connection
init.description: Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach the ecoNET module at {host} for 10 minutes. If its address or login changed, enter the new details. Leave the password blank to keep the saved one.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ecoNET device.
error.wrong_device: That address answers, but it is a different ecoNET controller from the one this integration was set up with.
error.already_configured: Another EcoNet Grant entry already uses this address.

abort.entry_removed: This EcoNet Grant entry no longer exists.

data_description.push_notifications: Send a push notification to all connected devices when a setting is changed externally (via the vendor app or control panel).
data_description.revert_notify_service: Companion App service name, e.g. mobile_app_your_phone (without notify.). Blank disables Revert buttons. Requires push notifications. Actions expire after 15 minutes; Safe Mode still blocks writes.
data_description.retention_days: Number of days to keep sensor readings and settings history (30-7300). Default: 3650 (10 years).
data_description.slow_poll_interval: Poll editParams and sysParams every 5-1440 whole minutes (default: 5). Longer intervals reduce device load but can delay changes not signalled by version counters. Version changes still trigger an early refresh. Saving options reloads the integration.
